name: mycrew-specialists
description: Layer 2/4 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who runs the build pipeline as coder-* skills and writes the code, and a designer, a UI/UX agent with taste who reads the product's MOOD.md and works against the real CSS frontend. Each keeps its own domain data under data/; the designer's catalog holds design systems to draw inspiration from, never to copy.
